notes.title: Chapter 7 Part 1 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First Steam update is finally ready.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43848254/9bf62b6b73a6447579d912c24fd351da470a72ff.png

Chapter 7 will be released in two parts: part 1 is out today; part 2 will be ready in about 5-6 weeks.

Please consider if you'd rather play each half of chapter 7 individually, or wait for the release of the full chapter.


Also, please note that this is a fresh update and may have bugs, typos and/or be in need of further editing. If you find any bugs, please be so kind and share them with me so I can fix them. Thanks for understanding. 


Chapter 1: ~7000 lines of script; ~710 images; 30 animations

Chapter 2: ~7200 lines of script; ~630 images; 13 animations

Chapter 3: ~9300 lines of script; ~540 images; 11 animations

Chapter 4: ~15000 lines of script; ~1120 images; 25 animations

Chapter 5: ~13400 lines of script; ~ 820 images; 25 animations

Chapter 6: ~19000 lines of script; ~1160 images; 50 animations

Chapter 7 part 1: ~8750 lines of script; ~700 images; 32 animations. 



I hope you enjoy the update!
